fullPassage: Roger Payne was born in Manhattan in 1935. He studied biology at Harvard University and eventually earned his Ph.D. from Cornell University in 1961. In 1967, he discovered that humpback whales make long and complex sounds. They're known as "whale songs," and he showed that whales use them to communicate. Then in 1970, he released an album of Songs of the Humpback Whale, which became a surprise hit and helped start the global "Save the Whales" movement. The following year, he founded Ocean Alliance to protect whales and the earth's oceans, and he used new, safe methods to study whales without harming them. Over his career, he led more than 100 research trips worldwide, including the Voyage of the Odyssey from 2000 to 2005, which studied ocean pollution. His work helped make laws that protect marine mammals, which finally led to the global ban on commercial whaling in 1986.

❌ ④ protects: 바로 앞에 'laws(법들)'가 나오는데, 이건 여러 개(복수)예요. 복수 주어를 받는 동사에는 -s를 붙이지 않아요. 그래서 protects가 아니라 protect가 맞아요. ←정답

✅ ① make: 'humpback whales(혹등고래들)'는 여러 마리(복수)라서 동사 make가 맞아요. (복수 주어라 makes가 아님)

✅ ② released: '그가 앨범을 발매했다'는 과거의 일이라 과거형 released가 맞아요.

✅ ③ founded: '그가 단체를 설립했다'도 과거라서 과거형 founded가 맞아요. (found=설립하다, 과거형 founded)
det.tip: 관계대명사 that 뒤 동사는 앞의 명사(선행사)에 맞춰요. laws(복수) → protect. 'laws that protect marine mammals'가 올바른 형태예요.

✅ ② the earth's oceans(지구의 바다): Ocean Alliance가 지키려는 대상 — 정답

❌ ③ the high mountains(높은 산): 고래·바다와 관계없어요.

❌ ④ the dry deserts(마른 사막): 문맥에 맞지 않아요.
det.tip: 단체 이름 Ocean Alliance(바다 연합)가 단서. 고래와 함께 지키는 건 '바다(oceans)'예요.
